verdict.rationale: A live probe confirmed https://developer.box.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured "Box Dev Docs" index. Box also publishes agent-oriented Markdown renditions of its docs (e.g. /_llms/en/home.md and agent-configurator.md), and the llms.txt content itself covers agent workflows such as mounting Box folders into agent runtimes. Missing for 10: no evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (e.g. an llms-full.txt), and no independent hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these docs.
